start_trigger: Hi, I missed a call from this number

game.help_text:
Commands:
RESET — restart your progress
STATUS — show the current clue
game.already_finished_text:
You have already completed what was asked of you.

Send RESET to begin again.
game.not_started_text:
No active thread detected.

Use the correct opening message to begin.

start.intro_text:
You didn't miss a call.

This only works if someone answers.

There are six places on this property that need to be followed in the correct order. If you move through them properly, you'll reach what has been set aside.

-------

finish.text:
You followed it correctly.

All the way to the room set apart from the house.

Gold still catches there. Green leather still remembers where it used to live.

What was set aside was always here —
but not for everyone.

You reached it because you followed the sequence.
Exactly.

Take the eggs.

The rest was never meant for you.

checkpoints.label: 01-monkey-puzzle-tree

clue.text:
LOOK NEXT:

Begin where something does not quite belong.
Ancient. Armored.
Called by a name that sounds more like a warning than a plant label.

Araucaria araucana.

checkpoints.success_text:
FOUND.

Good.

The first point always feels accidental.
It isn't.

The sequence has started.

-------

checkpoints.label: 02-old-chicken-shed-wood-shed

clue.text:
LOOK NEXT:

Find the structure that changed duties without losing its shape.
Timber rests where life once scratched and nested.
Something that still holds its former purpose, even now.

checkpoints.success_text:
FOUND.

Correct.

It only works if you move forward from the right place.

Most would miss that.

-------

checkpoints.label: 03-old-gum-tree

clue.text:
LOOK NEXT:

Find the oldest authority on the property.
Not the house.
Not the people.

The one that has hosted wings and hives
and outlasted every plan made around it.

checkpoints.success_text:
FOUND.

You are following correctly.

There is only one path through this.

You're still on it.

-------

checkpoints.label: 04-round-tree-seat

clue.text:
LOOK NEXT:

Seek the circle built not around people, but around a wooden sentinel.
Iron lace.
A boundary that doesn't explain itself.

Something ornamental,
until you realise it isn't meant to be crossed.

checkpoints.success_text:
FOUND.

This part tends to slow people down.

It should.

Not everything here is meant to be approached directly.

-------

checkpoints.label: 05-bird-house

clue.text:
LOOK NEXT:

Find the weathered little settlement raised above the ground.
Too many openings.
Too many ways in.

Less a nest than a place something could return to,
again and again.

checkpoints.success_text:
FOUND.

Almost there.

If you've followed it properly,
you already know where this leads.

-------

clue.text:
LOOK NEXT:

Where gold is worked into holy faces.
Where a green leather place to settle sits slightly out of time,
as if it remembers another life indoors.
